verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a per-endpoint API reference, with inline OpenAPI 3.0.1 specs, endpoint descriptions and request examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in the browser (no try-it console or sandbox execution). missing for 10: documented interactive try-it/runnable request console, runnable code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration of interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Every endpoint reference page publishes its machine-readable spec inline
